steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya, Closure, this plate is yours now.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We've had to rush getting it to you. There's a lot of facilities about the plate that still need repairs. Odds are, it'll be asking a lot of TLC from you—

options: The industry capacity is a rare luxury in Londinium.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I know. It's just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Londinium only emerged from the ashes of war not long ago. Given Victoria's current situation, it can't afford to divert so much production into one single plate.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Exactly. Heck, look how much you managed to optimize the plate structure for us. You are lifesavers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Siege, you've done far, far more than we could ask for already. Thank you. So, so much.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Compared to what Rhodes Island does, it's a drop in the bucket—

options: Says the Siege of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: ...Fair dos.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Once Rhodes is rebuilt, I'll pop by the Training Room as soon as I can.

options: I'll get you a top sparring partner. Top of the top.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Haha, deal!

steps.name: Sympathetic Assistant
steps.text: Madam Speaker, we can't afford to dawdle any further, else we won't be in time for the next grand opening...

spans.text: Madam Speaker, we can't afford to dawdle any further, else we won't be in time for the
next
grand opening...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Right then, everyone, see you later—

steps.name: Sympathetic Assistant
steps.text: Madam Speaker, photos, photos!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Well... as representative of Londinium, I hereby express my most solemn grief for the losses you have suffered, and my most sincere condolences. May we meet once more upon a reborn Rhodes Island.
Vina extends a hand.
The Doctor and Amiya shoot simultaneous glances at the same woman, who is presently lost in a stupor.

options: (Closure.)
(Hiss) Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whuh!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: As representative of Rhodes Island, I thank Victoria for its support in the Rhodes Island reconstruction efforts, and I look forward to the day we meet again, Vin—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Sorry, Sie—

options: Madam Speaker Alexandrina.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I told you, I wasn't spacing out, I was busy thinking over how we're gonna allocate the plate's subdivisions.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Besides, isn't Amiya supposed to be the handshaker for stuff like this?

options: But you're Rhodes Chief Engineer.
But it was a plate transfer ceremony.
But Kal'tsit did leave primary responsibility with you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I know, I'm just—*sigh*.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no need to sigh, Closure. You've already done amazingly, honestly.

options: Photos can't speak. Who'll know you bungled Vina's name?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Duh, right! I totally forgot it was for a photo—

options: But you DID look real embarrassed.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Doctor, for today only, the Rhodes Island Procurement Department will be hiking your quotes by 50%.

options: Have you no mercy?
But my hot water kettle JUST broke...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Come to mention, Closure, when we first set out for Victoria from Rim Billiton, you were the one to drum up our spirits again, weren't you?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I mean, I found a little chocolate in the supplies we managed to rescue, and shared it around with whoever was closest. No big deal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Plus you gave that rousing speech—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, you can stop now—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it really was a great source of encouragement for us.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh!

options: Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's not too late to beg my forgiveness. You add any more fuel to the fire and Procurement's price hikes are gonna be...

options: It's a tough road ahead.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

options: I know it was Kal'tsit's will...
But if the burden's too heavy to shoulder...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Phew, I thought you were gonna gripe at me again.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look, she left this to me. The only way for me is forward now. I'm not about to get cold feet—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Closure. Here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Booze?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Take a swig, pull yourself together, then look over this. Engineering drew up preliminary spreadsheets for the plate renovations.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This is a lot of spreadsheets!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Sure is. Want a swig?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Pass.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This much is peanuts. If you want, I could draw you up a ream of spreadsheets thiiiiiiis thick.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Respect.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doc, Amiya, I'm gonna go talk shop with Mechanist. You need anything, come find me, okay?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure's become so...

options: Dependable?
Concerned?
Good at putting on a brave face?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's always been dependable, you know! It's just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So you're as concerned as I am...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. She has the greatest workload of anyone in Rhodes Island on her shoulders right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, don't you think we should help by shouldering some of that burden?

options: Everyone heals in their own way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You mean...?

options: I'm just making an educated guess.
Help her if you want, how you want, Amiya.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Right, right, right, cool, cool.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yep, we'll go with that. Call me again if there's any more fuss with the mobility layer. Bye-byeee.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Man, it's been ringing off the hook all afternoon. What now...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yyyello?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: —The Snack Network got busted by Hibiscus?! I'll be right there!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? She let us off...? You're telling me Hibiscus, Hibiscus, gave the Snack Network a pass?

spans.text: Huh? She let us off...? You're telling me Hibiscus,
Hibiscus,
gave the Snack Network a pass?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Yeah, that's fair. They work around the clock too these days, they need the energy top-up as much as we do... I forget she's grown. Everyone's grown.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This shipment's already earmarked for keeping our regulars supplied, though. I'll think of a way to cover Medical. Ciao.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Phew... small potatoes, small potatoes...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I already know Medical wants in on the snack supply. Visiting me isn't gonna make it happen any faster—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Medical? Snack supply?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Rubbing temples) Guess you're not here about that, then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We already agreed, didn't we? Check in with me for anything else, but run Medical's business your own damn self.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I know, but our department's stockpile is in trouble. That includes production of anti-Oripathy medication.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The medical supplies are one thing, but pharmaceutical ingredients are a market commodity...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Got it. No issues with the production equipment, right?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Not in itself. We're just out of ingredients, so nothing's operating.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lemme see... We can procure this one from Kazimierz, and I'm... pretty sure there's manufacturing for this one at the Duke of Caster's, so we've gotta find a negotiator to run talks with her. This one's... uhh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Origins for this one... guh, northern Leithanien... that's crazy far! Where's a small supply region somewhere closer... Tara?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh, you're KIDDING me... Hold one sec, Warfarin...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That you, Doc? Perfect, I dunno what you're calling about, but an order of business just came up here that I think has your name on it—

spans.text: That you, Doc? Perfect, I dunno what you're calling about, but an order of business just came up here that I
think
has your name on it—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? You already wrote to Na Saoirsí? Nice going, Doc, I owe you one. Is that what you called to tell me?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Sure, sure, sure, we'll have sandworm legs, they'll be on your desk tomorrow.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: All solved?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Guess so.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Are you hanging in there?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hanging in there is my middle name! Anyway, if you're all settled, quit loitering here. I've still got debugging on ZOOT to run. You must be busy at Medical, yeah?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Not as busy as you are.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't often hear words like that out of your mouth. What, is Medical hoping for a budget increase?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm worried about you. How many hours of sleep a day have you been getting recently?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Enough to keep me alive.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm serious. You've had too much pressure on you lately.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh, jeez, all you do is worry over nothing. Go on, scram.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (Shrug)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *sigh* Seriously...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Four hours is plenty, and I split it up into four micronaps. Besides, I pulled this routine all the time back in Kazdel...

spans.text: Four hours is plenty,
and
I split it up into four micronaps. Besides, I pulled this routine all the time back in Kazdel...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Yawn) Maybe I'll get an hour's snooze in now.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lights off—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Not a good moment, I take it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not the worst. What did A6—no, I know your problem kids are on best behavior these days. Aw, man... is it HR?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It is HR, in fact. We received a few resumes that... er, maybe you should get some sleep first. I'll come back in an hour—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No big. Pass 'em here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, this one's a hard pass. Follow up on these two, though, set up face-to-face—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't tell me they're already at Reception?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No, not at all. Based on their addresses, you'll only be seeing them in a month at the earliest.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One month... lemme see...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Will a month and a half out work?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think we can arrange that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then a month and a half it is. Cheers.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I gotta get some...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...sleep?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Damn, no. I need to keep it at four hours a day, and I need it in one-hour chunks. There's gotta be a solution...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Sleep's just one issue, anyway. I can't fall behind on Rhodes Island reconstruction work either. Ugh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lemme think... an alarm? No, just an alarm won't cut it. I need something smarter, more comprehensive, more reliable, and it's gotta be something that won't tax our available resources...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Mm-hm... only one thing for it.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Even breathing)

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: She's asleep...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: In that case, I'll just leave Dr. Warfarin's report right...

steps.name: THRM-EX
steps.text: Detected keyword 'Warfarin'! Detonation imminent—

steps.name: THRM-EX
steps.text: Deploying thermal shock!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: WHOAAAAAAAA! WARFARIN! What's up with Warfarin?!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: C-Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Rubs eyes) Oh, it's you. Go on, what does Medical need?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: A shipment of pharmaceutical ingredients arrived from Tara, and they're not up to the same standard as the batch before... but Medical was hesitant to jump the cannon. Take a look...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...I'll head there now.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: By the way, what did THRM-EX just...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, there's been a ton on my plate recently, right? So I took the liberty of 'mobilizing' all the support robots a little.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: THRM-EX sits by my side while I'm sleeping now. He's got a new keyword capture unit, so if he detects one, he can wake me up.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: With... an explosion?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Potayto potahto, tomayto tomahto. Let's hustle down to Medical, alright?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nice, nice. I think with this, work on the Training Room's pretty much a wrap. You're gonna put me out of a job at this rate.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Far from it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, I've gotta head down to—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I know, I'll bug Engineering to deliver you the testing-spec practice targets ASAP. And if it's about ZOOT's reservation system, that's almost done with debugging too. I've been stretched thin the last few days, just hold on a little longer...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look, I'm only gonna be this real with you because it's you, but I'm drowning in all this work. I'm only getting an hour and a half of sleep a day at this point—do NOT make me hear it!

spans.text: Look, I'm only gonna be this real with you because it's you, but I'm
drowning
in all this work. I'm only getting an hour and a half of sleep a day at this point—do NOT make me hear it!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Calm. I have no intent to beleaguer you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...*exhale*.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: If you require rest, I could deliver you an incantation.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I appreciate the sentiment. It's not like I can't sleep at night, I've just got too much on my plate to—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: See? Just talking about it summons the damn...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yes? They confiscated a Procurement shipment at the checkpoint? I—

spans.text: Yes?
They confiscated a Procurement shipment at the checkpoint? I—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who is this? The Oripathy meds? I said those were Warfarin's bailiwick... These are for keeping the Reception Room stocked? Uh, okay, that is my turf...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The corner four-person dorm rooms' beds don't fit? You're kidding me, we ordered those to fit—did our supplier pinch pennies on us?

spans.text: The corner four-person dorm rooms' beds don't fit? You're kidding me, we
ordered
those to fit—did our supplier pinch pennies on us?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm warning you now, I have enough small potatoes as it is, and if it's not major, I WILL hang up! I'm BUSY here!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: —ZOOT errored out again?

The young Banshee watches with some concern as the Vampire fishes out four terminals at once and sets about attacking four problems at once in complete disorder, almost as if she's arguing with herself.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Closure—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't, don't worry, I like potatoes. This is how it is, people want me all around the clock for stuff.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Castle-3!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Launch auto-recovery mode.
Without waiting for a response to her command, the Vampire dismantles a portion of Castle-3's outer hull, and connects the four terminals...
...as well as three more of her as-of-yet quiet terminals to Castle-3, one by one.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'll just have Castle-3 sort any simultaneously incoming comms by order of priority...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And anything that's not too important, he can stave off with a quick response, while I deal with the urgent stuff first.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What do you think? Smart, right?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Anyway, enough jibber-jabber, I've got ZOOT to attend to! Let's go, Castle-3!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, you're here.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Closure!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *huff*, *pant*, *pant*...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Blaze, Gol... Goldenglow. You sort everything out at the Gododdin branch?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yup. Just little hiccups. Here's the report.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Cool, you can... put it here.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Closure... are you feeling poorly?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No. I'm good.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: But... you've got horrible bags under your eyes. It almost looks like you have eye masks on.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That—okay, I want a haircut next time that'll hide my dark circles, deal?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just so happens I got the hair salon fixed up, GG. Go see if it suits you. If you've got any complaints, I want them submitted to me in writing.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Alright! Thank you, Closure!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Way to get li'l Susie out of your hair like that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who's getting who out of whose hair?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay. Why don't you tell me what Lancet-2's doing stuck to your side?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She... she just likes going on walks with me—

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Lovely Ms. Closure, the results of my calculations indicate a: Thirty-seven point nine percent chance you can enter sleep mode in the next ten minutes.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Latest update. Justice Knight is forcibly inviting Operator Chiave to a game of Barrage Fortress in order to delay his travel. The chance you can enter sleep mode has risen to: Fifty one point nought percent.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I recommend you take a brief rest in this period.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There you have it. Excuse me while I go snooze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Closure—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: PhonoR-0? If it's not urgent, it can wait. I'm gonna take a sec to—

steps.name: PhonoR-0
steps.text: I know. A ten-minute sleep.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't bother me right now, then. You want a matte pink livery?

steps.name: PhonoR-0
steps.text: Regrettably for you, such a threat would only work on Mr. Friston-3.

steps.name: PhonoR-0
steps.text: Whose condition you know has been maladious of late, else it would not fall on my shoulders to advise you in your work.

steps.name: PhonoR-0
steps.text: Your workload is only set to increase further. To consult Lancet-2's statistics, your average time spent not working per day is: Fifty-nine minutes.

spans.text: Your workload is only set to increase further. To consult Lancet-2's statistics, your average time spent
not
working per day is: Fifty-nine minutes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then stop camping my sleeping time if you know already. I'm warning you, I don't need Logos to incant at me, and I don't need your—

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Lovely Ms. Closure, latest update. Your chance of entering sleep mode in the next twenty-four hours is: One hundred percent.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Did your system bug?

steps.name: Castle-3
steps.text: All communications resolved. No new communications are forecast for the next twenty-four hours.

steps.name: THRM-EX
steps.text: Once you returned to the Engineering Department, my keyword capture module did not capture any keywords worth waking you up over.

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: Beep-beep. Operator Chiave lost in a Barrage Fortress duel and resolved to polish his gaming skills. He has now gone to look for Operators Broca and Aosta.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Am I hallucinating? From overwork? Is that what this is?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: (Worried gaze)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, you still look normal at least. Are they telling the truth, Mr. Friston?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can actually get some sleep?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: You're due for some rest.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I dunno, something about this still seems super weird to me, but...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whatever! I'm sleeping!
The obviously exhausted Vampire flops headlong onto a camp bed in the corner.
...losure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Shaddup... whozzit...?
Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Mom, I told you I'm not coming down from the loft. Leave me alone—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your Highness?! Why are you here? Don't tell me—
I'm here to laud you for your diligence.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's weird, I've got this vague feeling that's not what you're supposed to say, it'd be more like 'I'm looking for someone who can break the shackles of tradition' or something...
The shackles of tradition? You've already broken them.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: H—Have I?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But I... uh, look, I'm just someone who does random crap in my loft. All that Kazdel's Elite 100 stuff, I made it up. Nothing about me screams diligence, haha...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Besides, this is the first time you've ever met me, I...
Is it really?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: R—Right, we've known each other for... ages? It's been... forever since I saw you? But...
The Vampire feels her head being softly caressed by a pair of strange yet deeply familiar hands, and she can't help but sniffle.
Now, now. We can reminisce about the olden days later. Right now, I wonder if any amount of praise would be enough to reward all your achievements.
Come. Let's see the fruits of your efforts.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Where are we...?
Surely you haven't forgotten? This is what you strove for, and in the end, fully completed... This is the New Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Strove... completed... New Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Right! Yeah, that sounds familiar!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Aha, ahahahahah, work's finally over... it's finally over!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your Highness, I need to thank you for reminding me. I always felt like I'd be at this for another half a month at least, another half a half without basically any sleep...
This is the playroom you poured your heart into designing. How lengthily you wracked your brains, wanting to remind our operators of times past, yet not so much as to stir their emotions turbid...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How do you... know I...?
This is the mobility layer, one to match that of any nomadic city upon this great land. The sleep you lost, the meals you forewent, to upgrade the plate's propulsion systems...
This... is the Medical Department.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Closure, we've got an issue here...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Y-Your Highness, isn't there still unfinished work here I have to...
Don't fret.
This figure of Closure's dream weaves an Arts she's never seen before, and in a blink, the whole plate suddenly shudders a few times, before softly rumbling to life.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Wh-What was that?
Closure has completed all that she can. Now comes my turn to help her a little.
With the help of Arts, all that is here will no longer trouble Closure. All that is left for her to do is nod a few times, pen a few signatures, and push a few buttons.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Really? Let me see...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What? The issue really is gone! How?
Let us go, Closure. To the destination of this journey, and the most important of places. The Engineering Department.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wow... everything is exactly like how I envisioned it. More advanced comms systems, more accessible control logic, and all the footfall circulates around the place just how I like it...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your Highness, I...
Shouldn't this be a happy occasion? Come, don't shed such tears.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I just... feel like—it was so much struggle—to get to this point...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't mean the timeline of this thing, it started... so much earlier, it started when you pushed open my door...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Back then, I never imagined some nonconformist Vampire screwing around in databases would have Her Highness Theresa trusting her with all this responsibility...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whenever I argued with my folks, it was the way they harped on about 'duty' that made me maddest. What did a Vampire's duty have to do with me?
But you love to build things.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...I do.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It went from weird and wacky terminals in Kazdel, to building Babel, to building Rhodes Island...
Be they data or constructs, your unending passion to build the things you've built has helped more than you can know... and as a matter of course, brought responsibility upon your shoulders.
And never have you shied away.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *sniff*...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your Highness... oh, erm, I wish you could—and I wish Kal'tsit—could...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Your Highness... Your Highness, aren't you right here? Why am I... huh?
Let's forget the gloomy talk for now. Come, take a look at your present. A present like no other, for you and you alone.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The chair in the center of the room? That wasn't in my blueprints.
That is the Rhodes Island Chief Engineer's throne.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A—A throne?
From now on, all you need to do is sit atop this throne... and eat chocolate.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Eat chocolate?
If chocolate is not your desire, there are also potato chips here, and candied fruits, and biscuits...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, Your Highness, I mean... what about my work?
...After so long exhausting yourself, do you truly wish to return to work?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I... ugh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, of course I don't wanna work if I don't have to! But—just sitting here eating chocolate, I feel like... even if witchcraft could solve all my problems, I'd still wanna... ugh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can't figure out how to word it, but this doesn't seem right. I need to... ugh, I need to...

spans.text: I can't figure out how to word it, but this doesn't seem
right.
I need to... ugh, I need to...

steps.text: Then farewell, until we meet again, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What? You're gonna say goodbye to me just because I don't wanna sit on a throne eating chocolate?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Ah, you're awake.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Warfarin, you did something shady to me, didn't you?! Fess up, what did you make me drink?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Cross my heart and hope to die, she didn't do anything.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I can attest to the same.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then it was you, Logos! I told you I don't need your incantations—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You went to sleep all by yourself.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...I went to sleep by myself? Me?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, I get it now, all the bots kept pushing me to sleep... Mechanist, what did you do to them?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: (Holds up hands defensively) All the info they told you was the truth. Besides, they're your domain. No one on Rhodes Island knows them better than you.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Still, good thing you're awake now. I was almost gonna wager with Logos whether you'd wake up before someone woke you up.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Apologies.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Alright, alright, all's well that ends well. Let's all get back to our posts now!
In short order, most of the people in Engineering empty out.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I vaguely remember Lancet-2 telling me something about twenty-four hours... How long was I out?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, you slept... exactly twenty-four hours.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You slept a whole day and night without any sign of waking up. That's why we were all gathered here, discussing whether or not to wake you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A whole day and night?! Oh, crap, I'm so screwed! I can kiss goodbye to sleeping for the whole of next month at this rate—

options: Not so fast.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're here too, Doc?

options: Amiya's been worried sick about you.
I've been worried sick about you.
Everyone's been worried sick about you.
So, while you were sleeping...
Amiya had us all divvy up your work.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *exhale*...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thank you. All of you, so much.

options: I helped draw up your daily itinerary, too.
I reassigned some of the less critical work for you.
Now you'll get five, six hours a night, minimum.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Once again, thank you. And also, all your chocolate and chips and fruit candy and cookies for the next month are free of charge.

options: But you can't be Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, I don't really wanna get into this right now—

options: You can inherit her all-consuming sense of mission...
But overwork won't transform you into her.
There are other ways to prove her will lives on in you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rebuilding Rhodes Island is a job with a thousand faces. You've suffered more than enough for it, Closure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope, with the Doctor's adjustments, your work schedule can allow you to breathe a little easier.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Elite Ops are all busy with their own stuff too. You sure allocating my work to them won't be too much trouble?

options: Beats seeing a repeat of your last couple days.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Hrmph.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Since you care so much about me, Doc, mayyyybe I could sleep another eight hours or so...
Closure looks at the Doctor, face brimming with expectation, only to notice a strange shift in the expression concealed beneath the hood, after which...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Why'd the Doc just fall over like a plank?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor hasn't... caught a wink of sleep in the last twenty-four hours either.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Blah. Never mind, then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Besides, seems like things aren't so urgent now. Don't mind me while I goof off a little—

steps.name: Castle-3
steps.text: Master Closure, I have three unanswered calls the Doctor was not able to pick up within five minutes. They came respectively from the Engineering, Medical, and Procurement Departments—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: AUGH!!!
